- **[Linked Issue / roles](#linked-issue--roles)** -- Public task, related issues, the donor issues closed after merge, and roles.

## Status

**REVIEW READY** at `1098978f4a931a667e147b68a791520eb141c917`; `771-pin4-93fb0b2d-55680bff` -> `dev`.

**Round 2** answers R683-1 and R684-1 ([assignment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/772#issuecomment-6342664760)):

- **The firmware ACMP walk failed at the adopted processor pin.** Processor #189 (PR #195) models a Talker Advertise / Failed swap in SETTLED_RSV_OK as no arc, with REGISTERING_FAILED following the registered type. The production firmware already does this: its SRP delivery hands the swap to `acmp_tk_kind_changed`, which updates the view and notifies. Only the walk's test adapter sent it to `acmp_tk_registered`, which refuses outside SETTLED_NO_RSV. That is case (a). The adapter now delivers it as the firmware does, the adopted oracle is unchanged, and `acmpwalk` passes 127 / 0. Two planted controls, the swap's kind lost and its notification lost, are each KILLED by the walk and by the stack's own test. A probe on the composed production firmware shows the same on the production path.
- **Documentation only:** the register map, pin page and changelog name the eight-identity bound on the appended path (R683-1-F2). Five parent contracts state the adopted count meaning (R683-1-F3). The three RTL files change in `//!` comment lines only.
- **Round 1b's gate claims were wrong.** It reported every local gate green, but the firmware gate set had not run, and `test_ctrl_firmware.py` failed at `a97aea01`. The validation below lists what ran at this head.

At `1098978f4a931a667e147b68a791520eb141c917` the full local firmware gate set (`docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:3158-3172`) passes with the verified RV32 SDK:

- `test_ctrl_firmware.py --require-rv32 --self-test`: 66 arm tallies, 1,593 checks, 0 failures; control mutants 521 of 521 caught; AECP and SRP campaigns 358 caught, 0 escaped.
- `test_ctrl_nvm.py --self-test`: 435 tests, 109 of 109 planted defects caught.
- The coverage ratchet holds.
- `ctrl_boundary.py --selftest` passes.
- `tally_selftest.py --mutants` passes.

The other gates at this head:

- The full parent sweep: 63 / 63 suites, 2,189,520 checks, 0 in-suite failures, 0 timed out.
- The physical gPTP leg: 209 checks, 0 failures.
- Yosys: 58 / 58 tops.
- behave: 406 scenarios.
- xvlog: 0 findings (`hdl/` and both pinned processors).
- The hosted docs-check steps under GNU Make 4.3: 44 steps; 42 run, all rc 0; 2 skipped by rule.

Round 1b (below, unchanged in substance): round 1 stopped on the resource gate. The [owner decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/771#issuecomment-6333175429) accepts the adoption's area for now, and this round finishes the assignment from that point. All three resource endpoints are re-recorded under that exception (section Description). The 8x8 standalone synthesis is measured. The three-directive image build passes every corner. Yosys passes 58 / 58 tops. The full parent sweep passes 63 / 63 suites with 2,189,520 checks and 0 in-suite failures. The physical gPTP leg passes 209 checks. behave passes 406 scenarios. The eight parent patches run together on this tree, and no interface changes beyond what they carry.

### Round 2: the firmware walk, on the production path

Case (a) of the assignment applies. The production firmware already follows the #189 behaviour, so `third_party/tsn-c-stack` is unchanged.

| Production step | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| SRP delivery | `sw/firmware/ctrl/app/ctrl_app_srp.c:90-100` | A registered sink in SETTLED_NO_RSV goes to `acmp_tk_registered`. A registered sink whose kind differs (SETTLED_RSV_OK) goes to `acmp_tk_kind_changed` |
| The swap | `third_party/tsn-c-stack/src/acmp.c:1176-1187` | Only in SETTLED_RSV_OK: sets the kind, then `finish()`. No state change and no SRP call |
| View, notification and wire | `acmp.c:431-432`, `:441-448`, `:495-515`, `:891-892` | REGISTERING_FAILED is part of the reported view. `finish()` notifies once when it moves. GET_RX_STATE carries it |

| Run (GoogleTest 1.14.0) | Result |
|---|---|
| `acmpwalk` at `a97aea01` | 127 checks, 1 failure (`TK_REG_SOK`: registered state and notification), reproducing both reviews |
| `acmpwalk` at the head | 127 checks, 0 failures |
| Control `acmp-kind-lost`, planted and judged by the campaign's own `plant()` and `caught()` | KILLED by `AcmpCore.KindChangesOnlyTheSettledView` and walk `TK_REG_SOK` "registered state" |
| Control `acmp-kind-not-notified` | KILLED by `AcmpCore.KindChangesOnlyTheSettledView` "kind change notifies once" and walk `TK_REG_SOK` "notified exactly when a Table 5.22 item moved", the walk's only failing check |
| Composed production firmware (`ctrl_app` with SRP, real mailbox MSRP vectors, real ACMP wire), `SrpFeedback.*` at one and two interfaces, plus a probe-only check that each swap notified | Unchanged firmware: 19 tests pass. `ctrl_app_srp.c`'s `acmp_tk_kind_changed` call dropped: state, wire and notification fail. The stack's swap muted: only the notification checks fail |

The saved-state capture is not re-measured. The product firmware digest it pins is unchanged (`497845e6...`), and only firmware test files changed.

### Resource re-baseline under the owner exception

The adopted image grows beyond the resource gate's tolerances, which stopped round 1. The [owner decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/771#issuecomment-6333175429) accepts the adoption's area for now; Mark II (#640) addresses it. All three endpoints are re-recorded with `record --write`; tolerances, floors and ceilings are unchanged; each record note cites the decision and the per-donor ledger below.

| Endpoint (Vivado 2026.1, the recipe's single-worker synthesis) | #708's record | Dev `d77a8afd` | Adopted, recorded | This adoption | Tolerance |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `route-1x1` LUT / FF | 49,613 / 52,353 | 49,989 / 52,622 | 50,759 / 52,832 | **+770** / +210 | 500 / 600 |
| `ooc-1x1` LUT / FF | 23,314 / 19,821 | 23,366 / 19,823 | 23,828 / 20,000 | **+462** / +177 | 250 / 250 |
| `ooc-8x8` LUT / FF | 30,211 / 27,451 | 30,282 / 27,451 | 32,467 / 28,220 | **+2,185** / **+769** | 316 / 339 |

Dev's own measurements pass against #708's record at every endpoint. The route keeps 122 free slices, RAMB36 / RAMB18 / DSP unchanged, WNS +0.291 ns and WHS +0.036 ns. In the routed image the +770 LUTs split into the gPTP plane, +415, and the processor wrapper, +353. At 8x8 the growth is in the SRP listener (+2,112 LUT / +720 FF against #708's record), which processor PRs #195 and #198 change; PR #198 reported its own 8x8 cost as +1,335 / +618. The decision quotes the 1x1 figures; the 8x8 figure is recorded under the same exception and stated here so it can be reviewed.

1x1 cost of each separable donor change: `KL_pp_shadow` or `KL_gptp_shadow` standalone synthesis at the 1x1 product shape, one point per first-parent merge, each with its own generated ROMs. The processor rows sum exactly to +462 / +177.

### Image

The three-directive image build (`build.sh ax7101 --sweep`'s launch lines, run one at a time) passes the build gate at every corner for every directive. The selected ExtraPostPlacementOpt image: Slow WNS / WHS +0.291 / +0.102 ns, Fast +1.660 / +0.036 ns; 100,659 of 100,659 nets routed; IOB packing 21 PASS, 0 FAIL; bitstream 3,825,992 bytes, SHA-256 `d785871ca41f9a8aecd23150c525949624be848cc19d5d29e9234b8bc63c9deb`; `flashboot_layout.json` binds it and the 7,512-byte AEM image; the offline image preflight (`deploy.sh check-images`) passes. AltSpreadLogic_high reached +0.083 / +0.004 ns and ExtraTimingOpt +0.297 / +0.004 ns.

The builds ran with `--vivado-max-threads` 2 (ExtraPostPlacementOpt) and 1 (the other two) instead of the launcher's 32: at 32, Vivado starts seven synthesis processes, which exceeded this host's per-job memory cap. The thread count is host-dependent by the launcher's design (`min(cores, 32)`); the 2-thread image reproduces the single-worker resource measurement exactly.

## How to get into the same state

Set `REPO` to the candidate checkout. Set `VERILATOR`, `MARKDOWN_PYTHON`, `MAKE43_BIN`, `RV32_SDK`, `LITEX_PYTHON`, `VIVADO_BIN`, `TSN_GEN_ROOT` (tsn-gen built at the `TSN_GEN_REV` of `.github/workflows/rtl.yml`) and `WORK` to the local dependencies and an empty external work directory. Before any command inside a submodule, verify its own top-level directory.

```sh
cd "$REPO"
git remote get-url origin
git rev-parse HEAD
git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor third_party/tsn-c-stack third_party/lwSRP
test "$(git -C protocol-processor rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$PWD/protocol-processor"
test "$(git -C gptp-processor rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$PWD/gptp-processor"
git submodule status protocol-processor gptp-processor
python3 scripts/ci_rv32_sdk.py --destination "$RV32_SDK"   # a new directory; add --archive <verified download> offline
python3 scripts/ci_rv32_sdk.py --destination "$RV32_SDK" --verify-only
export VERILATOR VERILATOR_JOBS=2 PYTHON_CPU_COUNT=4 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 TSN_GEN_ROOT
export MILAN_RV32_CC="$RV32_SDK/bin/riscv32-linux-gcc"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$GTEST_1_14/lib/pkgconfig" LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$GTEST_1_14/lib"
export PATH="$MAKE43_BIN:$CLANG_18_BIN:$VIVADO_BIN:$PATH"
make --version
"$VERILATOR" --version
```

`GTEST_1_14` is a GoogleTest / GoogleMock 1.14.0 install (the hosted runner's version) and `CLANG_18_BIN` a Clang 18 bin directory: the TSN stack's own gate inside `ctrl_boundary.py` refuses other versions. `LITEX_PYTHON` must have `sw/litex/litex_pins.txt`'s seven revisions installed. `ctrl_boundary.py` runs its builders with its own interpreter, and `sw/litex/test_ctrl_memory.py` imports migen.

Expected: origin `https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga.git`; head `1098978f4a931a667e147b68a791520eb141c917`; processor `93fb0b2d736b36588ea7321e25fba2f8819ea41f`; gPTP `55680bff3b287b9a7b0c759f51471fa617c17335`; GNU Make 4.3; Verilator 5.050.

Expected: every command exits 0. In detail:

- The ROM ledger regenerates byte-identically.
- The sweep: 63 / 63 suites, 2,189,520 checks, 0 in-suite failures, 0 timed out. The physical leg: 1 / 1 suite and 209 checks.
- Yosys: 58 / 58 tops, with 0 unjustified tied inputs. behave: 14 features, 406 scenarios and 1,977 steps.
- `test_ctrl_firmware`: PASS, with `acmpwalk` 127 / 0 and `mutants: 521 of 521 caught`.
- The shard proof: 941 live invocations, each in exactly one shard.
- The saved-state gate: OK over 5 shapes, 435 tests and 109 planted defects.
- The coverage ratchet: PASS on 30 files. `ctrl_boundary`: PASS.
- xvlog: 0 findings.

The resource records follow `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md` (`--single-thread-synthesis`, a fresh external `WORK`, the 8x8 parameters from an RTL elaboration); `pp_resource_gate.py check` against each new record then returns 0 for these inputs. Against #708's record (the parent of `76b01906`) all three return 1, which the owner decision accepts.

## Known limitations / out of scope

- The resource growth is accepted under the owner exception, not within policy: route +770 LUT over dev (tolerance 500), ooc-1x1 +462 (250), ooc-8x8 +2,185 LUT / +769 FF (316 / 339). Mark II (#640) addresses it.
- The image build used `--vivado-max-threads` 2 and 1 instead of the launcher's 32, because of this host's per-job memory cap. The launch lines are otherwise the launcher's own.
- The hosted docs-check gate steps ran literally at the head under GNU Make 4.3: 44 steps; 42 run, all rc 0; 2 skipped by rule. Two steps were skipped by rule. `docs-check-no-git` deletes `.git`, so its two gates ran in place. The act-runner contract step would execute the candidate's runner on the host. The builder legs keep their documented NOT RUN arms: the MAKEFLAGS mutation under Make 4.3, and the absent calibration build tree.
- The saved-state capture was not re-measured. The product firmware digest is unchanged (`497845e6...`), and `scripts/check_nvm_capture.py` passes; the retained 8x8 maximum is 13.863 ms against 24.5 ms.
- The firmware gates ran with the host's gcc 16.2.1 and GoogleTest 1.14.0, not the runner's GCC 13.3. `ctrl_boundary.py` ran under a LiteX interpreter whose seven packages are at `litex_pins.txt`'s revisions, with the project's `sw/litex/patches` applied, where the hosted job installs the pins alone. The hosted `firmware-*` jobs at this head are the manager's.
- `python3 scripts/ci_events.py --firmware-census` (listed after the firmware block in `CI_WORKFLOWS.md`) exits 1 here, and exits 1 on dev `d77a8afd`'s own inputs with byte-identical output. Its baseline step list predates the job-budget, package-cache and evidence-recording setup lines now in the four firmware jobs. No test command is missing. This PR changes none of its inputs, and it needs its own Issue.
- R683-1-R1 (the `scratch only:` comment at `hdl/milan/KL_pp_shadow.sv:1281-1282`, from the supplied scratch TSpec patch) is left for the residue checklist, as R683-1 lists it. R683-1-S1 (the `ucode.hex` Makefile prerequisites) is a suggestion and is not taken.
- Processor PR #194 says #190's first item, the CRF stream declaring MaxFrameSize 29, needs a second parent step. That step drives the CRF slot with 20 + 8 x timestamps_per_pdu + 1, adds a suite case and corrects `KL_crf_tx.sv:206-211`. The supplied patch drives every slot with today's value, so the CRF declaration is unchanged. Closing processor #190 after merge leaves that step open.
- #770's content is not in this lane.
- No push, PR, merge, hardware or bench operation was performed.
